sources.note: No descriptive (grammar/phonology/sketch) reference attached at all; only overview/comparative items.

Its value here is the extra spellings Varsaf / Varsav for future searches and the confirmation that the one SIL Vanuatu document it draws on (Bryant 2023, unpublished Global Voice Event report, Luganville) lists no entry for Farsaf.

sources.citation: Takau, Lana, Tom Fitzpatrick, Mary Walworth.. Tihomir Rangelov & Russell Gray. 2025. Vanuatu Voices v1.4 (lexibank CLDF wordlist), doculect Narango (290 forms, source 'Rangelov2022'). Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.17407434;https://vanuatuvoices.clld.org/languages/Narango
sources.note: Audio wordlist with segmental transcriptions only; zero stress marks in the 290 Narango forms; no prose on prosody.

sources.citation: Rangelov, Tihomir. 2023. Higher numerals in the languages of Espiritu Santo. Presentation + abstract, Vanuatu Languages Conference, July 2023 (MPG PuRe item_3659385; CC-BY). 'Newly collected data from 15 varieties' of Santo.
sources.note: Nothing on phonology, stress or tone; numeral systems (ligatures, terms for 100/1000/1,000,000, Tutuba running numerals).

sources.citation: Rangelov, Tihomir. 2023. The acoustic and articulatory properties of the prenasalised coronal trill in two Oceanic languages. In R. Skarnitzl & J. Volín (eds), Proceedings of the 20th International Congress of Phonetic Sciences (ICPhS 2023), Prague, pp. 3417-3421 (paper ID 1031).
sources.note: Nothing on stress. Only phonological remarks on Farsaf: NDR contrasts with plain /r/, apparently no coronal plosive, prenasalisation contrast in bilabial and velar plosives; and the explicit statement (p. 3418) 'Farsaf lacks proper phonological analysis and description.' Data = one 32-year-old male speaker, wordlist recorded in Narango village late 2022.

sources.citation: Rangelov, Tihomir. 2022. Farsaf (Narango) wordlist audio recordings (source 'Rangelov2022' in Vanuatu Voices; possibly also within the restricted Santo Language Survey deposits, Zenodo 17179135 / 17229251).
sources.note: Citation-form audio of ~290-500 words would let a reader determine stress placement by ear even though no description exists; the public CLLD site plays audio per item.

sources.citation: Rangelov, Tihomir. 2022. The languages of Santo and the Vanuatu Voices database. Talk slides, Friends of the Museum series, 6 December 2022. Leipzig: MPI-EVA (MPG PuRe item_3492326; CC-BY; 30 MB PDF).
sources.note: No phonology content for Narango/Farsaf at all: the only mention is the field-trip site list. The only phonological remark in the talk concerns Nokuku ('Interesting phonology - expanded vowel system + final vowel loss'). Full PDF read via extracted text; a full-text search for stress/accent farsaf|narango|nambel|stress|accent|tone|prosod|syllable = one hit (the site list). Extract kept, 30 MB PDF deleted.
